newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.77 pct at Italy dollar repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.77 pct at Italy dollar repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's $4.0 billion Bank of Italy three-month repurchase tender was 6.77 percent against 6.85 percent at the previous one-month tender.
The average indicative rate was 6.78 percent from 6.88 percent at the last foreign currency-denominated repo for 3.0 billion marks on June 18.

The Bank said the tender was fully subscribed and the funds assigned at a minimum 4.22 forward points above the 1,689.25 lire per dollar floor set by the Bank of Italy. The Bank received 24 bids of which 15 were met in full and two in part.
